epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration of a payment gateway, specifically Stripe, for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the user

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys and setup payment gateway

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment form and validation
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form with credit card input fields and validation

tasks.title: Integrate payment processing with order management
tasks.description: Update order status and trigger payment confirmation email

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and billing information
The system cancels subscriptions and stops recurring payments when requested by the customer

tasks.title: Implement subscription plan management with Stripe
tasks.description: Create, update, and delete subscription plans using Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI for customers
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for customers to manage their subscriptions

tasks.title: Handle subscription webhooks and update customer subscriptions
tasks.description: Listen for Stripe webhooks and update customer subscriptions accordingly

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can monitor and respond to payment issues
stories.description: Implement payment event handling and notification system
acceptance_criteria: The system sends email notifications to administrators for successful payments and payment failures
The system logs payment events and provides a dashboard for administrators to monitor payment activity

tasks.title: Implement payment event logging and dashboard
tasks.description: Create a logging system and dashboard for payment events

tasks.title: Develop email notification system for payment events
tasks.description: Create email templates and implement email sending for payment events

tasks.title: Integrate payment event handling with Stripe webhooks
tasks.description: Listen for Stripe webhooks and trigger payment event notifications

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access the application
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate the user's email and password
The system should redirect the user to the dashboard after successful login
The system should display an error message for invalid email or password

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user email and password

tasks.title: Create login form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the login form and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement redirect to dashboard after successful login
tasks.description: Create a function to redirect the user to the dashboard after successful login

stories.title: As a user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the application
stories.description: The system should allow users to create a new account
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate the user's email and password during signup
The system should send a verification email to the user after signup
The system should display an error message for duplicate email or invalid password

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation during signup
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user email and password during signup

tasks.title: Create signup form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the signup form and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement email verification after signup
tasks.description: Create a function to send a verification email to the user after signup

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The system should send a password reset email to the user
The system should validate the password reset token
The system should update the user's password after successful reset

tasks.title: Implement password reset email sending
tasks.description: Create a function to send a password reset email to the user

tasks.title: Create password reset form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design and implement the password reset form and handle form submission

tasks.title: Implement password update after successful reset
tasks.description: Create a function to update the user's password after successful reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can access the application easily
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub
acceptance_criteria: The system should redirect the user to the OAuth authorization page
The system should handle the OAuth callback and authenticate the user
The system should display an error message for OAuth authentication failure

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization flow with Google
tasks.description: Create a function to redirect the user to the Google OAuth authorization page

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization flow with GitHub
tasks.description: Create a function to redirect the user to the GitHub OAuth authorization page

tasks.title: Implement OAuth callback handling and user authentication
tasks.description: Create a function to handle the OAuth callback and authenticate the user

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events, such as user signup, payment success, and password reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a welcome email after signing up, so that I can verify my email address and get started with the application
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to users after they sign up, with a verification link to confirm their email address
acceptance_criteria: The welcome email is sent to the user's email address within 1 minute of signing up
The welcome email contains a verification link that redirects to the application's login page
The welcome email is sent only once per user, even if they sign up multiple times with the same email address

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome email
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for the welcome email, including a verification link

tasks.title: Integrate with SendGrid to send welcome emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with SendGrid to send welcome emails to users, including handling bounces and complaints

tasks.title: Test welcome email functionality
tasks.description: Test the welcome email functionality, including sending emails, verifying links, and handling edge cases

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a password reset email when I forget my password, so that I can reset my password and regain access to the application
stories.description: The system should send a password reset email to users when they request a password reset, with a link to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The password reset email is sent to the user's email address within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
The password reset email contains a link that redirects to the application's password reset page
The password reset link is valid for only 1 hour and can only be used once

tasks.title: Implement email template for password reset email
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for the password reset email, including a reset link

tasks.title: Integrate with AWS SES to send password reset emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with AWS SES to send password reset emails to users, including handling bounces and complaints

tasks.title: Test password reset email functionality
tasks.description: Test the password reset email functionality, including sending emails, verifying links, and handling edge cases

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a payment receipt email after making a payment, so that I can verify my payment and keep a record of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt email to users after they make a payment, with details of the transaction
acceptance_criteria: The payment receipt email is sent to the user's email address within 1 minute of making a payment
The payment receipt email contains details of the transaction, including date, amount, and payment method
The payment receipt email is sent only once per transaction, even if the user makes multiple payments with the same payment method

tasks.title: Implement email template for payment receipt email
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for the payment receipt email, including transaction details

tasks.title: Integrate with payment gateway to send payment receipt emails
tasks.description: Set up an integration with the payment gateway to send payment receipt emails to users, including handling payment failures and refunds

tasks.title: Test payment receipt email functionality
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt email functionality, including sending emails, verifying transaction details, and handling edge cases

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to be able to customize email templates and settings, so that I can tailor the email notification system to our application's branding and requirements
stories.description: The system should allow administrators to customize email templates and settings, including sender email address, email footer, and email content
acceptance_criteria: The system allows administrators to upload custom email templates
The system allows administrators to configure email settings, including sender email address and email footer
The system applies the customized email templates and settings to all email notifications sent to users

tasks.title: Implement email template upload functionality
tasks.description: Design and implement a feature to allow administrators to upload custom email templates

tasks.title: Implement email settings configuration functionality
tasks.description: Design and implement a feature to allow administrators to configure email settings, including sender email address and email footer

tasks.title: Test email customization functionality
tasks.description: Test the email customization functionality, including uploading templates, configuring settings, and verifying email notifications

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics and system health

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin should be able to create, update, and delete users, as well as assign roles and permissions
acceptance_criteria: The admin can create a new user with a unique username and password
The admin can update an existing user's role and permissions
The admin can delete a user and remove their access to the platform
The system prevents duplicate usernames and validates password strength

tasks.title: Design and implement user management database schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user information, including username, password, role, and permissions

tasks.title: Develop user management UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for creating, updating, and deleting users, as well as assigning roles and permissions

tasks.title: Implement user management business logic and validation
tasks.description: Write business logic to handle user creation, update, and deletion, as well as validate user input and prevent duplicate usernames

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin should be able to view dashboards displaying key metrics, such as active users, revenue, and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view a dashboard displaying the number of active users
The admin can view a dashboard displaying revenue metrics
The admin can view a dashboard displaying system performance metrics, such as response time and error rate
The dashboards update in real-time to reflect changes in the metrics

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics database schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store analytics data, including user activity, revenue, and system performance metrics

tasks.title: Develop analytics dashboard UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for displaying analytics dashboards, including charts, graphs, and tables

tasks.title: Implement analytics data processing and visualization
tasks.description: Write code to process and visualize analytics data, including aggregating data, handling errors, and updating dashboards in real-time

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin should be able to view system health metrics, including error logs, system performance, and configuration status
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view a dashboard displaying system health metrics, including error logs and system performance
The admin can view detailed error logs, including error messages and timestamps
The admin can view configuration status, including version numbers and update history
The system sends notifications to the admin when system health metrics exceed thresholds

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store system health metrics, including error logs and system performance data

tasks.title: Develop system health monitoring UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for displaying system health metrics, including dashboards and error logs

tasks.title: Implement system health monitoring and notification logic
tasks.description: Write code to monitor system health metrics, handle errors, and send notifications to the admin when thresholds are exceeded

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage configuration, so that I can customize the platform
stories.description: The admin should be able to view and update configuration settings, including version numbers and update history
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view a list of configuration settings, including version numbers and update history
The admin can update configuration settings, including version numbers and update history
The system validates configuration input and prevents invalid settings
The system updates configuration settings in real-time and reflects changes in the platform

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store configuration settings, including version numbers and update history

tasks.title: Develop configuration management UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for viewing and updating configuration settings

tasks.title: Implement configuration management business logic and validation
tasks.description: Write code to handle configuration updates, validate input, and update the platform in real-time

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time metrics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin should be able to view real-time metrics, including active users, revenue, and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view a dashboard displaying real-time metrics, including active users and revenue
The admin can view a dashboard displaying system performance metrics, including response time and error rate
The dashboards update in real-time to reflect changes in the metrics
The system handles high volumes of data and scales to meet demand

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time metrics processing pipeline
tasks.description: Create a pipeline to process and visualize real-time metrics, including data ingestion, processing, and visualization

tasks.title: Develop real-time metrics dashboard UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for displaying real-time metrics, including charts, graphs, and tables

tasks.title: Implement real-time metrics data processing and visualization
tasks.description: Write code to process and visualize real-time metrics, including handling high volumes of data and scaling to meet demand
